row.notes: Slot 1 of the speed-modifier vtable 0x145635080 built for every AI driver by Ai_Build_BehaviourSystem 0x1405f11b0 (ex Ai_ScDeltaPace). car = AiCarRecord (byte veh +0, handling +0x230, limits [+0x10]). Entry = [[ctx+0x10]+0xe8]+0x60[veh] cache, else search list +0x48..+0x50 by [[e+0x18]+0x58]+0xe8 == veh; acts only if e+0x69. gap = e+0x30 + under_safety_car.delta_pace_time_adjustment (handling +0x6c8, 0x14066981f); if gap >= 0: lap fraction from Game_VehicleProgressSystem_GetLapProgress (obf distance - lap * g_Game_TrackLength 0x146ce66b8, clamped, normalised); target = vcall +0x138 on [..+0x150] (spline speed at fraction, 0x1406698d2) * [..]+0x1c4 - delta_pace_high_speed_point (+0x6b8) * gap; if e+0x30 > 0 also - delta_pace_low_speed_point (+0x6c0) and, when [[ctx+0x10]+0xa8]+0x368 is an object of a specific RTTI type, target = its +0x4c (mph) * 0.44704 * 1.01. Writes [car+0x10]+0xdc = min(cur, target) with +0xe8 = 2, +0xec = 0xff (0x1406699bd); +0xe0/+0xe4 = min(1e38, cur). Used by vmknolle red-flag-pit / sc-unlapping.
